remarks: Welcome Home to 105 Rossler Avenue. Move-in ready and beautifully renovated, this Cheektowaga Ranch offers a spacious, creative floor plan with modern and thoughtful updates throughout. The stunning quartz kitchen features soft-close white cabinetry, a custom tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances and dramatic lighting. Bamboo hardwood flooring, craftsman-style trim, recessed lighting and six-panel doors add warmth and character throughout the main level. The spa-like full bath features a tiled floor and tub surround with top quality fixtures and finishes. The partially finished basement provides valuable additional living space, a rare half bath and abundant storage options. Significant capital improvements include an architectural tear-off roof and extensive interior renovations completed in 2019 including upgraded vinyl windows with custom blinds, two ductless A/C mini-splits with a heat pump recently installed in 2024 and an upgraded electrical panel in 2025. Enjoy peaceful evenings in the tree-lined backyard, complete with a stone fire pit area perfect for gathering with family and friends. The gas line-connected grill on the concrete patio makes outdoor entertaining easy. A large detached two-car garage provides limitless possibilities for parking, workshop space and additional storage. Conveniently located near downtown Buffalo, shopping, dining, parks, and everyday amenities, this inviting home has it all, blending modern comfort with functional spaces inside and out.
